newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar caps gains as arb sellers emerge.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar caps gains as arb sellers emerge.

text.p: White sugar futures staged a very subdued performance on Thursday as interest to sell the spot white premium after the New York open capped earlier gains and kept nearby values trapped in a range. Light buying by trade players pushed the March contract above its firmer open but then arbitrage sellers emerged and values started to slip, traders added.

The March/March white premium has now bounced back from a low of around $65 notched up on Wednesday. But the firmness in London widened the premium and drew sellers between $69.00 and $69.50, traders said.
"It (the premium) is a little bit stronger so people have been selling the strength in the afternoon," said one.
At 1640 GMT March was up just 10 cents at $304.00 after touching an intraday high of $305.20. May was down by the same amount and also at $304.00, leaving the nearby spread flat.

Volume was a very light 369 lots. Technically, March is holding well above the recent downtrend channel dating from mid-September and analysts said they would be looking for a close towards the day's highs as an indicator that upside momentum would continue.
Paris futures were similarly quiet with 325 lots traded. March was 30 cents lower at $303.70 and May was also 30 cents down at $304.00.
